# vis-network

TaskLinker vendors the browser bundle and stylesheet from `vis-network` 10.1.2.

- Source: <https://github.com/visjs/vis-network/tree/v10.1.2>
- Package: <https://www.npmjs.com/package/vis-network/v/10.1.2>
- Files: `standalone/umd/vis-network.min.js` and `styles/vis-network.min.css`
- Licence: Apache-2.0 or MIT, as preserved in this directory

The files are loaded only on TaskLinker's relationship graph page. Their presence and
version notice are checked by `tests/PresentationCompatibilityTest.php`.
